feat: add fractional reserve warning banner

## Summary
Adds a warning banner to alert users when the LNbits instance is operating on fractional reserves (when user balances exceed the underlying node balance). This improves transparency and allows users to make informed decisions about using the instance.

The banner only displays when:
- A real funding source is configured (not VoidWallet)
- The balance delta exceeds the watchdog threshold
- A user is logged in

## Changes
- Added FRACTIONAL_RESERVE boolean flag to helpers.py template context
- Implemented yellow warning banner with bold black text in base.html
- Added fractional_reserve_warning translation string to en.js

## Screenshots
Banner displays at the top of the page (inside q-header, before q-toolbar) with:
- Yellow background (`bg-warning` - Quasar default warning color)
- Bold black text for maximum readability
- Black warning icon
